SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, count(*) n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT status, fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(dispatch_ts_utc) disp, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) dist_orders, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wl AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, o.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) dist_grain, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonweb_store, sum(CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order,
 sum(CASE WHEN dd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_disp, sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test,
 sum(CASE WHEN dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) inrange,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM wl

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS sales, 0 AS ret
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, 0, r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(sales) gross_sales, SUM(ret) returns, SUM(sales-ret) net_sales
 FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
 GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) b, SUM(r.returns_net) rn, SUM(r.net_sales) ns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.*, c.b ctl_before, c.rn ctl_returns, c.ns ctl_net FROM mine m JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_period=m.fiscal_period ORDER BY m.fiscal_period
